subject: tablesync — a fictional command-line tool that copies Postgres tables to S3 on a schedule. Used as the subject of every task so the two sets describe the same thing.

tasks.prompt: Write the opening section of the README for tablesync: what it is, what it does, and why someone would use it. About 120 words.
The database password is wrong, so tablesync cannot connect. Write the error message the user sees. Say what happened, why, and what to do.
Write a getting-started section for tablesync: install it, write a config file, run the first sync. About 120 words.
Write a troubleshooting entry for tablesync: syncs are slower than expected. Cover the likely causes and what to check. About 120 words.
Write release notes for tablesync 3.0, which changes the config file format. Old config files no longer load. About 120 words.
Write an incident report: tablesync wrote partial files to S3 for four hours after a network change. About 120 words.
Write a runbook for the on-call engineer: tablesync has stopped syncing and the queue is growing. About 120 words.
Write an architecture overview of tablesync: how it reads from Postgres, batches rows, and writes to S3. About 120 words.
